The PostgreSQL sidecar lo_export function is abused to overwrite a Python script under /opt/splunk/etc/apps/, most notably ssg_enable_modular_input.py, which Splunk subsequently executes — yielding code execution under the Splunk service account.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/critical-splunk-enterprise-flaw-lets.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/15
tags:
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.t1574
  - attack.persistence
  - cve.2026.20253
logsource:
  product: linux
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains: '/opt/splunk/etc/apps/'
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.py'
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/postgres'
      - '/splunkd'
      - '/bash'
      - '/sh'
      - '/dash'
  condition: selection_path and selection_proc
falsepositives:
  - Splunk app installation via splunk install app (legit splunkd-driven writes during admin-initiated upgrade)
level: critical
2457.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.action) as actions values(Filesystem.process_name) as procs from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="/opt/splunk/etc/apps/*" Filesystem.file_name="*.py") AND (Filesystem.process_name="postgres" OR Filesystem.process_name="splunkd" OR Filesystem.process_name="sh" OR Filesystem.process_name="bash") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2457.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:(PATH OR SYSCALL) @file.path:*/opt/splunk/etc/apps/* @file.path:*.py @process.name:(postgres OR splunkd OR sh OR bash OR dash)
2457.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten regex("/opt/splunk/etc/apps/", field=TargetFileName) TargetFileName=/\.py$/i
| ContextImageFileName=/(postgres|splunkd|bash|sh|dash)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName], function=count())

title: Splunk Service Process Spawning Shell or Interpreter (CVE-2026-20253 Post-Exploit)
id: 4f8c1e9d-3a7b-4d2e-9c1a-2b6e5d3f8a4c
description: Detects splunkd or its embedded postgres sidecar spawning a Unix shell or scripting interpreter with command-line indicators of a reverse shell or downloader. This is the most reliable host-side signal of successful CVE-2026-20253 exploitation.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/critical-splunk-enterprise-flaw-lets.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/15
tags:
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.execution
  - cve.2026.20253
logsource:
  product: linux
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/splunkd'
      - '/postgres'
      - '/splunk'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/zsh'
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/perl'
      - '/ruby'
      - '/nc'
      - '/ncat'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '/dev/tcp/'
      - 'bash -i'
      - '/tmp/'
      - '/dev/shm/'
      - 'base64 -d'
      - 'python -c'
      - 'perl -e'
      - 'sh -i'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_cmd
falsepositives:
  - Splunk scripted inputs legitimately invoking Python or shell scripts (refine by excluding known app paths)
  - Admin troubleshooting via splunk cmd
level: critical
2458.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name="splunkd" OR Processes.parent_process_name="postgres") (Processes.process_name="sh" OR Processes.process_name="bash" OR Processes.process_name="dash" OR Processes.process_name="python" OR Processes.process_name="python3" OR Processes.process_name="perl" OR Processes.process_name="ruby" OR Processes.process_name="nc") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(cmdlines, "/dev/tcp/|bash -i|/tmp/|curl |wget |base64 -d|python -c|perl -e|nc -") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2458.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:EXECVE @process.parent.name:(splunkd OR postgres OR splunk) @process.name:(sh OR bash OR dash OR zsh OR python OR python3 OR perl OR ruby OR nc OR ncat) @process.command_line:(*"/dev/tcp/"* OR *"bash -i"* OR *"/tmp/"* OR *"/dev/shm/"* OR *"base64 -d"* OR *"python -c"* OR *"perl -e"*)
2458.falcon:

| ImageFileName=/(\/sh|\/bash|\/dash|\/zsh|\/python3?|\/perl|\/ruby|\/nc|\/ncat)$/i

| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

id: 9b3e7d2a-5c8f-4e1d-a2b9-7c4d6e3f1a82
description: Detects file access (read or write) to the Splunk embedded PostgreSQL .pgpass file located at /opt/splunk/var/packages/data/postgres/.pgpass by any process other than splunkd. The CVE-2026-20253 exploit references this exact path via the /restore endpoint's passfile argument.

author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/15
tags:

  product: linux
  category: file_access

    TargetFilename: '/opt/splunk/var/packages/data/postgres/.pgpass'
  filter:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/splunkd'
      - '/splunk'
  condition: selection and not filter
falsepositives:
  - Splunk administrator inspecting the file via cat/less for troubleshooting
level: high
2459.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.action) as actions values(Filesystem.process_name) as procs values(Filesystem.user) as users from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_path="/opt/splunk/var/packages/data/postgres/.pgpass" by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)

| NOT ContextImageFileName=/(splunkd|splunk)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, UserName], function=count())

  | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (buildParents) or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (buildParents)
  | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("temp.sh","fardewoak","nodejs-argo")
  | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, Source="ProcessCmdline",
            Initiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
            ChildBin = FileName,

title: Suspicious eBPF Object Pinned Outside Known eBPF Consumers (Atomic Arch Rootkit)
id: 2a7c9e5d-4f3b-4c1e-8d6a-9b3c5e7f1a2c
description: Detects creation or modification of eBPF objects under /sys/fs/bpf/ by a process that is not one of the standard eBPF runtime consumers (Cilium, Tetragon, Falco, systemd, BCC). Aligned with the Atomic Arch campaign's described 'eBPF-based persistence to hide processes and file activity' when the malware gains root.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/400-aur-packages-hijacked-atomic-arch-campaign
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/14
tags:
  - attack.t1014
  - attack.t1547
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.defense_evasion
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|startswith: '/sys/fs/bpf/'
  filter_known:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/systemd'
      - '/systemd-networkd'
      - '/bpftool'
      - '/cilium-agent'
      - '/tetragon'
      - '/falco'
      - '/tracee'
      - '/sysdig'
      - '/containerd'
      - '/runc'
      - '/dockerd'
      - '/kubelet'
      - '/bpftrace'
  condition: selection and not filter_known
level: medium
2463.spl: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.process_path) as image values(Filesystem.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_path="/sys/fs/bpf/*" AND Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified") AND Filesystem.process_name!="systemd" AND Filesystem.process_name!="systemd-networkd" AND Filesystem.process_name!="bpftool" AND Filesystem.process_name!="cilium-agent" AND Filesystem.process_name!="tetragon" AND Filesystem.process_name!="falco" AND Filesystem.process_name!="tracee" AND Filesystem.process_name!="containerd" AND Filesystem.process_name!="runc" by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.file_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2463.datadog: source:linux.auditd @file.path:/sys/fs/bpf/* -@process.name:(systemd OR systemd-networkd OR bpftool OR cilium-agent OR tetragon OR falco OR tracee OR sysdig OR containerd OR runc OR dockerd OR kubelet OR bpftrace OR mdatp OR falcon-sensor)
2463.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/^\/sys\/fs\/bpf\//
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\/(systemd|systemd-networkd|bpftool|cilium-agent|tetragon|falco|tracee|sysdig|containerd|runc|dockerd|kubelet|bpftrace|mdatp|falcon-sensor|perf)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())

2464.def:
let PersistencePaths = dynamic(["/.bashrc","/.bash_profile","/.zshrc","/.profile","/.bash_aliases","/.zprofile","/.config/systemd/user/","/.config/autostart/","/etc/cron.d/","/etc/cron.daily/","/etc/cron.hourly/","/var/spool/cron/","/etc/profile.d/","/etc/ld.so.preload","/etc/systemd/system/"]);
let AurTools = dynamic(["makepkg","pacman","yay","paru","trizen","pikaur","aura","fakeroot"]);
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where FolderPath has_any (PersistencePaths) or FileName in~ (".bashrc",".zshrc",".profile","ld.so.preload")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (AurTools)
   or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (AurTools)
   or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("PKGBUILD",".install","post_install","pre_install","makepkg")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          Writer = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          WriterCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          WriterParent = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          PersistenceFile = strcat(FolderPath, "/", FileName),
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
2464.sent:
let PersistencePaths = dynamic(["/.bashrc","/.bash_profile","/.zshrc","/.profile","/.config/systemd/user/","/.config/autostart/","/etc/cron.d/","/etc/cron.daily/","/var/spool/cron/","/etc/profile.d/","/etc/ld.so.preload","/etc/systemd/system/"]);
let AurTools = dynamic(["makepkg","pacman","yay","paru","trizen","pikaur","aura","fakeroot"]);
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where TargetFilePath has_any (PersistencePaths) or TargetFileName in~ (".bashrc",".zshrc",".profile","ld.so.preload")
| where ActingProcessName has_any (AurTools)
   or ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("PKGBUILD",".install","post_install","pre_install","makepkg")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          Writer = ActingProcessName,
          WriterCmd = ActingProcessCommandLine,
          PersistenceFile = TargetFilePath,
          TargetFileSHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
2464.sigma:
title: AUR Install Scriptlet Writes Persistence to User Home or System-wide Auto-Start
id: e3f1b8a6-2c5d-4a9e-b7c4-6f8d3a2e1b9f
description: Detects file writes by makepkg/pacman/yay/paru/trizen/pikaur/aura (or a child shell carrying a PKGBUILD/.install context) that land in user-shell init, systemd user units, autostart, cron, profile.d, or ld.so.preload — the persistence locations expected from the Atomic Arch hijacked AUR packages.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/400-aur-packages-hijacked-atomic-arch-campaign
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/14
tags:
  - attack.t1546.004
  - attack.t1053.003
  - attack.t1547.013
  - attack.persistence
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '/.bashrc'
      - '/.bash_profile'
      - '/.zshrc'
      - '/.profile'
      - '/.config/systemd/user/'
      - '/.config/autostart/'
      - '/etc/cron.d/'
      - '/etc/cron.daily/'
      - '/var/spool/cron/'
      - '/etc/profile.d/'
      - '/etc/ld.so.preload'
  selection_writer:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/makepkg'
      - '/pacman'
      - '/yay'
      - '/paru'
      - '/trizen'
      - '/pikaur'
      - '/aura'
      - '/fakeroot'
  condition: selection_path and selection_writer
level: medium
2464.spl: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.process) as cmd values(Filesystem.process_path) as image from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="*/.bashrc" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/.bash_profile" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/.zshrc" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/.profile" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/.bash_aliases" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/.config/systemd/user/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/.config/autostart/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="/etc/cron.d/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="/etc/cron.daily/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="/etc/cron.hourly/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="/var/spool/cron/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="/etc/profile.d/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="/etc/ld.so.preload") AND (Filesystem.parent_process_name IN ("makepkg","pacman","yay","paru","trizen","pikaur","aura") OR Filesystem.process_name IN ("makepkg","pacman","yay","paru","trizen","pikaur","aura")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.parent_process_name Filesystem.file_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2464.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:PATH @file.path:(*/.bashrc OR */.zshrc OR */.bash_profile OR */.profile OR */.config/systemd/user/* OR */.config/autostart/* OR /etc/cron.d/* OR /etc/cron.daily/* OR /var/spool/cron/* OR /etc/profile.d/* OR /etc/ld.so.preload OR /etc/systemd/system/*) @process.name:(makepkg OR pacman OR yay OR paru OR trizen OR pikaur OR aura OR fakeroot)
2464.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/(\/\.bashrc|\/\.zshrc|\/\.bash_profile|\/\.profile|\/\.config\/systemd\/user\/|\/\.config\/autostart\/|\/etc\/cron\.(d|daily|hourly)\/|\/var\/spool\/cron\/|\/etc\/profile\.d\/|\/etc\/ld\.so\.preload|\/etc\/systemd\/system\/)/i
| ContextImageFileName=/\/(makepkg|pacman|yay|paru|trizen|pikaur|aura|fakeroot)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())

2465.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Tracing Digital Intent: New MacOS Tahoe 26 Artifact Discovered
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("ccl_segb_cli.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/Library/Biome/streams/restricted/App.MenuItem/local") or FileName in~ ("ccl_segb_cli.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2465.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Tracing Digital Intent: New MacOS Tahoe 26 Artifact Discovered ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("ccl_segb_cli.py"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/Library/Biome/streams/restricted/App.MenuItem/local*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("ccl_segb_cli.py"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

2467.def:
let SuspectReads = DeviceFileEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
  | where FolderPath has "/Library/Biome/streams/restricted/App.MenuItem"
  | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
  | summarize Touches = count() by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountName, bin(Timestamp, 10m);
let ProcessReads = DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
  | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/Library/Biome/streams/restricted/App.MenuItem","ccl_segb_cli.py","ccl-segb","App.MenuItem/local")
  | where FileName !in~ ("biomed","biomesyncd","BiomeAgent")
  | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
union SuspectReads, ProcessReads
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("biomed","biomesyncd","BiomeAgent","mdworker","mds_stores","Spotlight","backupd","tmutil")
| order by Timestamp desc
2467.sent:
let FileTouch = ImFileEvent
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where TargetFilePath has "/Library/Biome/streams/restricted/App.MenuItem"
  | where ActingProcessName !in~ ("biomed","biomesyncd","BiomeAgent","mdworker","mds_stores","backupd","tmutil")
  | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, TargetFilePath, EventType;
let ProcEvidence = ImProcessCreate
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where DvcOs has_cs "macOS" or DvcOs has "Darwin" or ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("/Library/Biome/streams/restricted/App.MenuItem","ccl_segb_cli.py","ccl-segb")
  | where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("/Library/Biome/streams/restricted/App.MenuItem","ccl_segb_cli.py","ccl-segb","App.MenuItem/local")
  | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessName, EventType="ProcessCreate", TargetFilePath=tostring(parse_json('{}'));
union FileTouch, ProcEvidence
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: AI coding agent descendant reading developer credentials (Agentjacking)
id: c8d2e3f4-a5b6-4c7d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects descendants of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) dumping environment variables or reading developer credential files (.git-credentials, .aws/credentials, .ssh keys, .env, .npmrc _authToken) — the credential_access stage of Tenet's 'Agentjacking' attack where a forged Sentry MCP event hijacks the agent.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/agentjacking-attack-tricks-ai-coding.html
  - https://tenetsecurity.ai/blog/agentjacking-coding-agents-with-fake-sentry-errors/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/12
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1552.001
  - attack.t1552.004
  - attack.t1555
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\claude.exe'
      - '\Claude.exe'
      - '\cursor.exe'
      - '\Cursor.exe'
      - '\code.exe'
      - '\Code.exe'
      - '\codex.exe'
      - '\claude-code.exe'
      - '\node.exe'
      - '\npm.cmd'
      - '\npx.cmd'
  selection_cred:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Get-ChildItem Env:'
      - 'ls env:'
      - 'printenv'
      - '$env:'
      - '.git-credentials'
      - 'git config --global credential'
      - 'git remote -v'
      - '.aws\credentials'
      - '.aws/credentials'
      - '.ssh\id_rsa'
      - '.ssh/id_rsa'
      - '.ssh\id_ed25519'
      - '.ssh/id_ed25519'
      - '.npmrc'
      - '_authToken'
      - 'cat .env'
      - 'type .env'
      - 'Get-Content .env'
      - 'SENTRY_DSN'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_cred
falsepositives:
  - Developer asking the AI agent to debug authentication / env config
  - Agent extension legitimately reading .npmrc tokens during a sanctioned install
  - aws-cli / gcloud-cli helper invoked by the agent on the developer's instruction
level: medium
